title: Asset credits
description: Attribution for every shipped asset. ADR-0004: third-party assets are CC0 or CC-BY only, and every file under assets/dist must appear here.

path.description: Path relative to `assets/`, so `dist/level4/atlas.webp` for a shipped asset and `refs/ottawa/peace-tower-elevation.jpg` for a reference. That is the only accepted form: a `../` prefix was the pre-2026-09-08 convention and is now a hard failure, not a warning. The gate walks `assets/` and asserts set equality in both directions - a file with no entry is an uncredited asset, an entry with no file is a stale claim about a file that is gone.

kind.description: What this entry is. `shipped` is redistributed in the built game and is what the credit gate walks; `reference` is a drawing and verify-art input that ADR-0004 says is never redistributed, credited here only because there is no separate register. Optional until the credit gate learns the difference (ADR-0006, credit-scope obligation); required after that.

licence.description: ADR-0004, as amended: any licence permitting redistribution and modification with no copyleft, non-commercial or no-derivatives condition. ShareAlike of every version is deliberately absent - the ADR rejects viral terms for the same reason it makes original art CC BY rather than CC BY-SA. `public-domain` is not an SPDX identifier because SPDX has none for a work whose term has expired or that was never eligible; the `source` URL must evidence the status.
